Checking the KernelSU and Shizuku connection.
Run these in order if KernelSU modules or LSPosed do not activate.
Reapplies KernelSU modules. Does not restart the device or the Android app environment.
Restarts the Android app environment so LSPosed can apply.
Technical details and run history. Not needed for typical use.

RAM-only temporary root for SM-S948B AZG5. It does not modify the system partition or Knox, and root is cleared on reboot.\n\nSave important work because the device may reboot while the exploit runs. After success, manage per-app root permissions in KernelSU.

Runs the late-load, mount, and service stages again for all enabled KernelSU modules. This includes modules besides LSPosed, so disable any module you suspect is conflicting first.\n\nThis does not restart the kernel or the Android app environment. Run “Soft boot” afterward.

Complete “Reload modules” first. LSPosed and Zygisk are injected into the newly started Android app environment (Zygote).\n\nRunning this briefly stops active apps and System UI. On some devices it may turn into a full reboot, which clears temporary root.
